buried.claim: The first big forecast search found 1,217 forecast recipes worth trusting.
buried.result: Only 63 of the 1,217 earned the top grade on the second look. 337 held up, 564 did not reproduce at all, and 253 could not be tested. The book of promoted recipes was frozen at 388 entries.
buried.study: A second search, planned and written down before it ran, re-grading every one of the 1,217 recipes on a second set of data

buried.claim: The named setup families are good enough to trade live.
buried.maker: Our setup picker, checked against the forecast program's replay
buried.result: No setup family passed the go-live bar. The replay was itself reproduced case for case by a second run: its best family row scored an edge of +0.081 (range 0.029 to 0.133), and its baseline row scored -0.025.
buried.study: A replay of every historical case the picker would have taken, checked family by family against a go-live bar set in advance

buried.claim: A mechanical bull-flag breakout is the only setup you need: it makes money on its own.
buried.result: It lost 0.0345% per trade after costs, with a strength score of -3.56 (past -2 is strong evidence, in the losing direction). It also lost on the SPY and IWM checks, and none of 6 variations of the rule changed the sign.
buried.sample: 611 trades over 677 trading days (QQQ, 2-minute bars, January 2, 2024 to October 5, 2026)
buried.study: A frozen, pre-written test of the exact mechanical rule, run by us on index data

buried.claim: Those bull-flag breaks can double a same-day call option, up over 100%.
buried.result: Only 4.3% of breaks moved far enough in the right direction to double a call; the claim needed 25%. The middle break moved just +0.026% before costs.
buried.study: The same frozen bull-flag study, checking how far each break actually travelled

buried.claim: A multi-timeframe VWAP trend stack is a high-probability intraday trade.
buried.result: The breakout arm lost 0.026% per trade after costs, and lost 0.156% per trade in the held-back years. It could not beat random entries in the same stocks (strength score -0.06 against random). The study's own verdict: dead on the intraday horizon.
buried.sample: 251 breakout trades over 1,699 trading days (January 2, 2020 to October 6, 2026)
buried.study: A pre-registered test of the full stack in the 20 most liquid large stocks, run by us

buried.claim: Strong volume plus an RSI above 50 add edge to that VWAP stack.
buried.result: On breakouts, confirmed trades did worse than unconfirmed ones by 0.015% per trade (strength -0.53). On retests they did better by 0.054% (strength 1.73), below the +0.10% bar set before the test ran.
buried.study: The same pre-registered VWAP study, comparing trades with and without the two confirmations

buried.claim: The textbook pullback, buying a dip to the 20/50-day lines in an uptrend, earns money.
buried.maker: Trading-education sellers generally; the pattern is a staple of their courses
buried.result: It earned +0.05 of its risk unit per trade, no better than random entries in the same stocks (+0.08) or random days inside uptrends (+0.03).
buried.sample: About 85,000 trades across 6,385 stocks including delisted ones, 2016 to 2026
buried.study: An independent cross-check on deep price history, run by our research program

buried.claim: Buying dips in uptrends, a touch of the 20-day line with a trend filter, is a working strategy.
buried.maker: A strategy question we set ourselves
buried.result: In the held-back years it shrank money at 37.8% a year, with a strength score of -18.26 against picking random days instead. All 4 versions of the trigger failed the same way. The study's verdict: kill it.
buried.study: A walk-forward test (rules fixed in advance, tested on later years) across the full stock list

buried.claim: Buying washed-out pullbacks to support in uptrending AI stocks pays better, per unit of fall, than simply holding the semiconductor fund SMH.
buried.maker: Our AI top-50 pattern study, written up as a pre-registered test
buried.result: It grew at 9.84% a year with a worst fall of 27.25%: 0.361 of return per unit of fall, against SMH's 0.716. It failed 2 of its 4 pre-set marks and all 11 variations (best 0.517). It did pass its bear-market mark: its worst fall in the bear stretch was 1.21% against SMH's 45.30%, because it sat in cash on 98.66% of bear days.
buried.study: A pre-registered backtest with its pass marks set before it ran

buried.claim: The rebuilt confluence board's 0-to-100 score ranks the returns that follow.
buried.maker: A vendor's confluence design (Leadr), rebuilt by us with its settings verbatim and our own scoring arithmetic
buried.result: The score's ranking agreed with later returns not at all: the rank agreement was -0.014 at 1 day, -0.021 at 5 days and -0.010 at 21 days, which is zero for practical purposes.
buried.sample: 52,968 scored rows over 29 weekly dates, April 8 to October 23, 2026
buried.study: A backtest of every scored week on record

buried.claim: A chart ranker's 0.736 ranking agreement is a forecasting result.
buried.result: Ruled not a prediction: the 0.736 measures agreement with one fitted 55-name vendor snapshot, not agreement with future returns, and it was reached only after three rotation mistakes and a split-adjustment fault in the ranker's data were corrected.
buried.sample: One fitted snapshot of 55 names from the vendor
buried.study: An audit of the ranker and its data, inside our research analysis
